faqs.question: Do I need a boating license?
faqs.answer: No! Our circle boats are classified as personal watercraft and require no license or experience.

faqs.question: How fast do the boats go?
faqs.answer: Up to 5 mph with the 5-speed electric motor. Perfect for a relaxing cruise!

faqs.question: Can I bring my dog?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We even offer a Doggie Dock and Pup Pack add-on. Life vests included.

faqs.question: What if it rains?
faqs.answer: We monitor weather closely. If conditions are unsafe, we will reschedule or fully refund your booking.

faqs.question: Where do I launch?
faqs.answer: We meet you at 25856 Canal Road, Unit A, Orange Beach, AL 36561. Right on the canal!

reviews.text: Saw this bar on Diners, Drive-ins, and Dives and had to stop on our next vacation. After hiking at the near by Pattison state park, a burger was sounding delicious. We sat immediately and could not stop looking around at the nautical artifacts that covered the wall and ceiling of the bar. The menu has a variety of burgers only with homemade fries. Burgers were DELICIOUS and cheap! A must stop if your in the superior area.
What an awesome burger! The fries, drinks, and service were outstanding! Could not beat the price. Thanks to my boss and Triple D for the thumbs up. Can't wait to travel through here again.

You must go here!! Yummy burgers, and there is so much to look at, the walls are covered with nautical memorabilia... They opened at 11am, we were there by 11:10, before 11:30 they were completely full... Nice outdoor seating... The staff is very busy, but still are attentive... Can't wait to go here again!!

Looking for a good burger at a great price? For over 20 years, my family has enjoyed the Anchor Bar. Our favorite table is in the game room; it has a great view of the bar, yet it is private. Place your order then, people watch or play a game of cards until your hot basket arrives. I always order the cashew burger. My daughter loves the sour cream and mushroom burger while my son's usually get an Anchor burger with two patties or the three patty Gallybuster; we all order the yummy fresh cut fries.

You for sure gets your money worth here!! I've never left hungry and have never spent more than 10 bucks a person!! I've been satisfied every time. I'll make sure I go back every time I'm in the duluth/ superior area!
Best burger anywhere, period! I make an effort to go out of my way to get here anytime I'm up from Texas. Great fresh-cut fries too. Dirt cheap prices...awesome dive bar.
Angry Crab Shack is amazing! The food is delicious. I especially loved the gumbo! Be prepared to get dirty. Gloves and bib provided. Atmosphere is very fun and family friendly.
My favorite crab place ever! I love that you can customize your bags, flavor & heat! Indescribably good!

This Restaurant is Off the Hook and WOW is it Awesome. Wife and I ordered Bahama Bob burger and it was Great. Daughter and Son in law order the Seafood plate and they said it was Awesome and I think they have the Best Frys on the Beach cooked just right and real crispy. Our waiter Kevin was in a Zone was quick with our orders and making sure everything we ok Thank you Kevin for the Great Service. Also the Price is not bad for what you get. And we will be Back

This was hands down the best service I received the entire time I was in the area. I went out one day for lunch with my significant other and the hostess, waitress, and fellow customers were all SO friendly. The waitress was quick and charismatic, the hostess was extremely genuine and welcoming, and the fellow customers were quick to offer to take a picture for my significant other and I. It was only fitting for us to come back on our last night here. Again, a different hostess that was also very welcoming and personable, we had the same waitress who remembered us and was over the top with her excellent service! Not to mention the food here was incredible!

Today was our 1st visit to Bahama Bob's and we were not disappointed! The food was delicious and the portions were generous! Our group ordered the house gumbo, shrimp & scallop skewers with sides, fried mushrooms, onion rings and popcorn shrimp. Our server, Skyler, was excellent! She took very good care of us. This place is a little beach side jewel. Very friendly, cozy and very clean. We will definitely be back soon

Best boat rental experience in Orange Beach! The circle boats are so unique and fun. My kids absolutely loved it. Staff was super friendly and helpful getting us set up. Will definitely be back next summer!
We rented the double seater and a mini dock for our cooler. Spent the whole day cruising the intercoastal. So relaxing and the electric motor is whisper quiet. 10/10 recommend!
Took my dog out on the doggie dock — he had the time of his life! The boats are super easy to operate, no license needed. Great concept and great people running it.
Such a fun experience! We rented 4 boats for a birthday party. The group rate was a great deal. Only wish they had evening hours for sunset cruises.
These circle boats are genius. Portable, electric, eco-friendly, and an absolute blast. My family rented three and we had a flotilla going down the canal. Staff was awesome!

Good food! Friendly staff! The pizza crust is well done but not burnt, the cheese is perfect and the sauce is mild. It's a good bite of pizza. Also ordered the Italian sub and the beef and cheese sub. Both were prepared perfectly. You can really tell these guys know what they're doing! Worth the stop!

I had a sandwich delivered and completely forgot to get a receipt for work. So the next day I went to get a copy and had another sandwich since the previous one was absolutely fantastic! A gentleman dug through receipts and found it for me. Their food is top notch, but somehow their service is even better!! This will be a "must visit" restaurant every time I'm in town.

We ordered for carryout while on vacation. The man on the phone estimated 35 minutes until it would be ready. We got there about 30 minutes after and it was just finishing up. Everyone was friendly and helpful throughout the ordering and pick up process. We got the all meat pizza and the Buffalo chicken pizza + bacon and jalapeños. Both were delicious, but everyone especially loved the Buffalo chicken. We look forward to eating here again when we visit Gulf Shores.

Fried food is amazing (I'm from South Louisiana). You get plenty of food. Price meets up with all the near beach restaurants. The text you when your table is ready. Can have a snack in the parking lot at Sassy Bass while you wait. You can also get bar drinks outside to wait with. Average wait, average price, fantastic taste. Not too fancy, not too simple. Kid friendly menu. Grilled seafood options.

Went here tonight not knowing what to expect. It was wonderful. The food was excellent. Prices were average for fresh seafood. Service was great and everyone was pleasant. I would go there again and recommend to all my friends and family.

Took my family here on our vacation after reading good reviews. We all loved it! The staff was super friendly and the food was absolutely amazing and very reasonably priced. The inside of the building seems a bit old but don't let that turn you off. This place is delicious!

This place was absolutely amazing the food was very delicious the service was excellent and the price was very reasonable will definitely be back. Heather was our server and she was absolutely wonderful
Wonderful food and great service. Love the atmosphere here!
Great food.
Our server Ellie was great!!! We had the fried shrimp and The Grill Salad and our food was delicious and fresh. Best shrimp I've had here!! We'll be back
This is our all-time favorite spot for lunch!
Enjoyed our experience here! Best bushwhacker no doubt!
The seafood at Pelican Grill is unparalleled. Each visit leaves me with a memorable culinary experience.
The ambiance and service at Pelican Grill are exceptional. It's my go-to place for the freshest seafood in town.
Pelican Grill never disappoints. The flavors and quality of their seafood dishes are truly remarkable.
Whenever we're in town, we always eat at Perch. It's one of our favorites and has a view you can't beat!
Delicious food, great ambiance, and wonderful service! This was our third visit to the Perch. Always the best experience!
This place is one of my favorites in Gulf Shores. Nothing was left on any plate, and the cocktails were delicious. I am so excited to come back to Perch.

The 14-inch Meat Me in Maui pizza was delicious! The toppings were generous, the homemade crust had great flavor, and there was plenty of sauce to tie it all together. A great choice for anyone who loves a hearty, flavorful pizza!
We had the Kokomo with thin crust. It was excellent. The crust was crispy and the toppings were plentiful. Very happy and will be ordering from here again.

I stopped in and asked the Surfside Pizza team if they could make me something special that wasn't on the menu. They were happy to do it, and the pizza was ready in no time. I took it home, had my first bite, and was blown away—it was so good that I drove right back to the restaurant just to tell them! I've lived here for 20 years, and this is hands down the best pizza I've ever had.

I found Surfside Pizza in Orange Beach through a Google search and decided to try their delivery. I ordered a pizza and Cheese Pizza Sticks, and even though the estimated delivery time was 45 minutes, they arrived 10 minutes early—delivered by the owner himself! The food was excellent, and the customer service from the phone call to delivery was outstanding. Highly recommend!

First night of vacation, and we happened to stumble on The Cove. It was a fantastic stumble! Amanda (I'm going based on my receipt) was our server and she was amazing! She made us feel welcome and gave some great recommendations! This is a laid-back location, which was a definite plus! This is definitely a spot we will be adding to our vacation must visits!

I was ELATED by Tina's customer service skills. Great personality, composed, great work ethic and smiled the entire time. We had the Tuna Nachos as an appetizer (Sorry we all dug in like animals before I got a photo) and I ordered a Philly. We enjoyed our experience here so much, we came back and brought friends the very next day! This time I took Stuffed Avocado & I believe a blackened chicken quesadilla.

This was not only one of the best meals I've had at the beach it was one of the best meals I've had anywhere. We ordered the Philly cheese steak quesadilla and the blackened chicken quesadilla and they were phenomenal. We also ordered the tuna nachos which were some of the best nachos I've ever had. They're made with wontons and are incredible.

A family of six. Seated right away, served drinks. Ordered food. Food was served promptly and was warm and delicious. We had wraps, burgers and chicken Philly. It was all delicious 😋 Our waitress was very efficient and pleasant. Would definitely visit again!!
Incredible spot right on the river! We came by boat and docked at their pier. The Ahi Tuna Nachos were out of this world and the sunset views were unbeatable. Already planning our next visit.
Best seafood platter on the Gulf Coast, hands down. Huge portions, everything fried to perfection. The Bayou Burger is also a sleeper hit. Staff was super friendly and attentive.
We brought our own catch and they cooked it perfectly — the Hook & Cook is such a unique experience! Great atmosphere, live music on the weekends, and the key lime cheesecake is a must.
Great food and even better location. Fish tacos were fresh and flavorful. Only reason for 4 stars is we had to wait a bit on a Saturday evening, but totally worth it once seated.
Our new favorite restaurant in the Foley area! We had the Shrimp Po' Boy, Alligator Cheesecake appetizer, and the pizza. Everything was amazing. The riverside outdoor seating is beautiful.
Whenever we're in town, we always eat at Perch. It's one of our favorites and has a view you can't beat!
Delicious food, great ambiance, and wonderful service! This was our third visit to the Perch. Always the best experience!
This place is one of my favorites in Gulf Shores. Nothing was left on any plate, and the cocktails were delicious. I am so excited to come back to Perch.

By far the best experience we've ever had on a charter! Our family — 2 adults and 3 kids — had an absolute blast. My 15-year-old daughter caught a 20+ pound tuna and the younger ones enjoyed reef fishing. The crew was immediately responsive and made sure every rod was perfectly set up for us.

Captain Jon and his crew are the absolute best charter around! We did the 8-hour offshore trip and it was nonstop action. Caught amberjack, red snapper, and a huge king mackerel. The 47-footer has everything you need — A/C, Starlink, even beds. Can't beat it.

Took my dad out for his 60th birthday on the 6-hour deep sea trip. What an experience! The crew was informative and very helpful. We caught more fish than we knew what to do with. They cleaned and filleted everything right at the dock. Already booked our next trip.

First time deep sea fishing and Captain Jon made it so easy and fun! The nearshore trip was perfect for beginners. Saw dolphins on the way out and caught a ton of vermillion snapper and triggerfish. The boat is beautiful and well-maintained. Highly recommend!

We've fished with several charters out of Orange Beach and Kraken Reels is hands down the best. The equipment is top-notch, the crew knows exactly where the fish are, and the boat has every amenity you could want. Worth every penny for the offshore trip.
The atmosphere was relaxed, the service was wonderful, and they even had live entertainment
Such a fun place with music and great service. Awesome Happy hour prices
If we lived here we'd probably eat here 2x a week. It was our favorite place visiting Gulf Shores
My absolute favorite place to take my family and friends… The food is incredible!!
Very nice local off the beaten path find… shrimp & grits were superb… fast and friendly service.
BEST seafood I have ever had! Trigger fish with lobster sauce, stuffed mushrooms, and turtle cheesecake—amazing.

Best boat rental experience in Orange Beach! The circle boats are so unique and fun. My kids absolutely loved it. Staff was super friendly and helpful getting us set up. Will definitely be back next summer!
We rented the double seater and a mini dock for our cooler. Spent the whole day cruising the intercoastal. So relaxing and the electric motor is whisper quiet. 10/10 recommend!
Took my dog out on the doggie dock — he had the time of his life! The boats are super easy to operate, no license needed. Great concept and great people running it.
Such a fun experience! We rented 4 boats for a birthday party. The group rate was a great deal. Only wish they had evening hours for sunset cruises.
These circle boats are genius. Portable, electric, eco-friendly, and an absolute blast. My family rented three and we had a flotilla going down the canal. Staff was awesome!

Captain Colby was amazing! He shared his knowledge of the area, fishing hot spots, and was very patient with our kids. Our family had a great fishing experience, great catches for the day, and made lots of great memories! Highly recommend them, we will definitely be back!
Such an amazing adventure! The captain and mate made sure our trip was a memorable experience. We caught our snapper limit, along with some bonus fish. Zero complaints. We'll be back!
Zeke's Landing is the best marina on Alabama's Gulf Coast. Been fishing here since the 1980's. They offer hook-and-cook at the restaurant. Best place to watch sunsets too!
My son and I had a wonderful experience. Captain Ricky was great and definitely put us on the fish. We did an 8-hour trip and loved it. Would highly recommend!
Orlando delivered the cart and followed up to make sure we were taken care of. Will book with them again next time we are in the area!
We had a great time. Katie was very sweet and we enjoyed talking with her. Boat was fun and it was a great day for all of us.
It was such a fun time ! Captain Jason & Carlos  were very interactive! Thank you for the experience

It was freezing on the day we planned to go, but seeing the large group  of dolphins, including baby dolphins was worth the cold. A few people in our group said that was the most they have seen on cruises in the past.
Crew was great as was the weather! We were in a smaller boat, and were able to move around to get better views. Kids loved it! Water fight was a great extra for the kids!
Is was excellent
Had a great time, Kyle and Ryan was very entertaining and full of information!  Loved the water gun fight with the pirate ship.  Would definitely recommend for families and couples!

A boat is a boat and this boat was everything as promised but what made the difference for us was the crew helping us. You park almost in the boat and the deck hands will load your equipment for you help you on/off and are their to unload for you too. Booking through TripShock does not include tip so they charge a mandatory tip plus fuel fee but trust me the tip was worth it.
The whole experience was easy and we had a great time.  The slide was a nice touch too.  We would definitely do this again.
The reservation process and checkout was easy! We enjoyed our time together and the slide was a must for the 6 kids all 12 and under.

Employees were extremely nice and helpful. Pontoon was nice but motor would kick out of gear on a somewhat regular basis. Would have to pull back to neutral and then speed up again. Biggest complaint was Mandatory $80 fuel bill and gratuity. According to gauge, we used only 3/8 of a tank as we swam most of the day. Total rip off. I should pay only for fuel used. If I get good service, I'll reward it. Damn near $100 extra. Deck hand did a good job of explaining boat operation, but $100 for  15 minutes is a bit much. Finally, charging me $3 to park!!! I knew the charges and paid them. Doesn't mean I won't complain about it.
Enjoyed our time on the pontoon boat seeing the bay and trip to pirates cove but boat was old and not in great condition
I like too much and my kids too
Good customer service, good time on the boat with the music and the guide talking.  I got to see 3 dolphins so close and many times .
Had a great time. Captain Lynn and helpers were awesome. Our 13 year old grandson was very skeptical, but totally enjoyed himself. Would go again.
It was hands down an amazing trip! Captain Lynn was amazing! Great music, Great crew! Super friendly and amazing with kids!
Entertaining fun and informative and the Captain and crew were wonderful
It was very wonderful. Hayden was the perfect person to show us how to drive the pontoon and where to go. We had a great time and will use them again!!

The staff was AMAZING! The boat was immaculate! A printed map of the waterway would've been a little more helpful since we're not from the area, but we were able to make due. We had the MOST AMAZING day!!!❤️

Wonderful day on the bay renting a pontoon boat for the day.  It was in tip top shape.  My son and I fished in the morning and later in the afternoon picked up the rest of the family.  We took a cruise in the bay, had a picnic on an island and even watched dolphins from the boat.  I have disabled kids and the rental crew member went out of his way to be sensitive to their needs, helpful and even made sure we got them onto the boat without issue.  He really helped to provide a great experience overall for all of us.  It was the best service we received all week long.  Highly recommend!
This was everyone’s favorite part of vacation. Highly recommend!
We saw plenty of dolphins and the crew was great.

My family had the best time on this dolphin cruise! The captain and team were so entertaining! They even had a big live parrot on board! We did get to see dolphins swimming around us! It was great! Also, lots of seagulls chasing our boat and kids loved this part so much!! Best time ever!
Very fun, kid friendly and even gave kids Cheetos to feed the birds.
This was simply amazing! Everyone was friendly and kindhearted! The weather was definitely perfect.
Was a little skeptical with it being in the bay. But turned out to be the best dolphin cruise we've been on.
Captain and crew were amazing. Plenty of dolphins. Weather was beautiful. Couldn't ask for a better day.

Both captains very knowledgeable, they provide food to feed the birds. The dolphins really put on a show. We even had 2 mothers with their babies (about 3 months old at the time). You may even be able to get your picture with Lucy the Macaw.
This was the most fun part of our trip. Loved seeing the dolphins be active and so many of them, too. Thank you so much. We absolutely loved the cruise!
Even though it was a short helicopter ride, we got the chance to look for sharks in the ocean.  Well worth it!!
Great new adventure,  knowledgeable information shared
The tour was on time and top notch service! We will most definitely return for another tour!! it was awesome!!
The weather wasn't ideal
Said 7+ minutes on website but was only 3 minutes
AMAZING!!! So much fun and worth the expierence
Had the greatest time, would highly recommend it to anyone visiting Orange Beach.

We had so much fun. Our guides led us to dolphins and let us go at our own pace. They had a rough night (two skis flipped!) so we got 30ish less minutes than usual but was not on them at all. They didn’t want the skis out in the dark or they would’ve given us some more time. Friendly environment and was a warm welcome for our trip to Alabama
Our guide was top notch! Eli not only found dolphins for is, he provided a once in a lifetime experience.
We’ll be back next year when my daughter is old enough to drive. We had so much fun!

Great place to rent jet ski’s from.  The 2 gentlemen running the dock were knowledgeable, friendly and fun to rent from.  The No Wake zone was minimal, a short 2-3 min trip to open water.  The jet ski’s were well maintained and very fast.  Definitely better experience than the competition we rented from 2 days prior.
Friendly staff, very explanatory,  loved the riding.
The best. The staff were great and polite very helpful. Would highly recommend to any and everyone. Very satisfied customer. Will be coming back again.

I took my 4 and 7 year old out on the jet ski for the first time. Everything was fantastic from the moment we got there. Directions were clear and we also saw some dolphins while we were out on the water. It was a highlight of our trip and my kids can't wait to do it again.
The Water Ride and Jet Ski was property and staff were good; the rental place wanted a 3.5% if using a credit card!
Captain was right on time, very knowledgeable, made sure everyone was safe and had a good time. Highly recommend
From the time we left the dock and until we arrived the Captain was very nice and went the extra mile to make sure we had a great time.
Our Dolphin cruise on Sunny Lady was awesome, had a beautiful day. The day of our cruise was our anniversary (11/15). Had a great time. Crew was professional, fun time. Will book again.

Captain Matt was the best! He is very knowledgeable and personable. He shared lots of information about the dolphins with us and made sure we got some great views. He also knew a lot about the area and shared some interesting insights with us. He gave us a card with restaurant recommendations in the area and every one that we have tried that he recommended has been great! Highly recommend the private dolphin tours with Captain Matt for the best views and experience!
Matt was excellent.  I'll do it again when I come back to Gulf Shores.

We decided on a private dolphin/sunset cruise to celebrate our 40th Wedding Anniversary! Matt was an awesome guide! We saw a lot of dolphins and he did a great job informing us about the dolphins and area as well! The boat ride was very smooth and enjoyable!  We will definitely be doing a cruise with him again!
Had a private dolphin tour with Captain Don.  He was polite, informative but let us enjoy our time together as a family. And he found us all the dolphins!!!! Exciting and recommend them!
Even if we hadn't found the dolphins it would have been worth the money, for the boat ride and seeing the sunset. It was so much fun.
We had a blast. Unfortunately our trip was cut a little short due to lightning but other than that it was fun!!

We did a private one hour tour.  We saw a lot of dolphins including several babies around 3 weeks old.  Our Captain was entertaining and knowledgeable.  My wife gets seasick so he kept us in smooth waters.  We enjoyed it very much.
it was an enjoyable experience. My family and I loved it.
Really nice 2 hour excursion. Saw numerous dolphins swimming in front and along sides of boat. Well worth the cost for sure
This was such a great experience. Not only were there several dolphins but the crew was great and the sunset beautiful.
We had a phenomenal time. We did get to see lots of dolphins and the staff seemed very knowledgeable.  Would definitely recommend...
Beautiful day, we saw many dolphins!

Aaron (captain) & Mark (crew member) were very knowledgeable as well as entertaining.  We did see several pods of beautiful, graceful dolphins.  That being said, i would not book another cruise with the Southern Rose Dolphin group. 

The boat never left the Ono Island area of the bay.  We watched/followed the same pod of dolphins in a very limited area. 

The dolphin cruise was listed as 1.5-2hours.  It started at 3pm; we were in our vehicle pulling out by 4:20pm.

You have to pay a 15% fuel fee on top of what you've already paid, which was around $9.

We had so much fun! THANK YOU!
Hosts were friendly, funny & kind- much appreciated.

It was my 25th birthday, along with my friend and his wife’s wedding trip! They got married in gulf shores and I got the pleasure of witnessing it and spending my 25th down there as well. I wanted to parasail to celebrate and they tagged along. River and rider was probably two of the coolest people we met along our trip. Hearing how long they’ve been doing it and the way they’ve made it a lifestyle was amazing to us missouri boys! They done a great job at taking care of us and making sure we knew the whole run down before we ever even got out of the no wake zone. Killer music, killer vibes, and a killer birthday! Thanks, fellas! I hope to visit again one day!
My Grandchildren really enjoyed the Parasail Ride. Although, we did not expect to be in the boat with many other people and also wish that the ride had lasted longer.
Our guides were knowledgeable and funny. We felt very safe at all times and had a blast!
Jake and Hunter we very professional knowledgeable and safe.. they gave us the best parasailing experience
We had a great time. Saw several dolphins and just enjoyed the scenery. Hunter was super great along with the entire staff. Would definitely recommend it to everyone.
Absolutely wonderful! So relaxing. Saw lots of dolphins and birds. Get the souvenir cup! 10/10 would recommend

Being an ole boy from Louisiana, and booking on line , I can tell you I hit it out the park with this cruise , Johnny, Lexie and Hannah are top notch , very knowledgeable and hard working

The staff was very helpful and the boat was well equipped   The family had a great time  renting the lily pad  or lounge was a must   If I had to have one ding it would be that the boat was under powered  but overall a great experience
Friendly staff!  Will do everything to make your trip the best!  The kids enjoy this day the most every year.
The staff was extremely accommodating.
Great time with all the grandchildren!  Priceless

The slide on the boat did not have ample water to supply it for our kids and no pump to pump from the waterway to it.  So we ran out .  We used very little before we ran out. We used barely two gallons of fuel and brought it back in early .

Pontoon with slide is nice! We enjoyed our 4 hours.

Boat was clean and in good condition with life jackets provided in all sizes. We only ventured out to one of the islands and 4 hours was plenty of time for lots of fun. The island was beautiful with lots of hermit crabs and crystal clear water. This was definitely worth experiencing.
Excellent Trip! Attentive staff, friendly and helpful with any questions or comments. We had a great trip!!

We Rentes the boat with the slide and had so much fun. 4 hrs on it. The little islands where you could park and relax on had room for everyone. There were a lot of jellyfish around that area so we avoided it. Life jackets available for everyone. The kids had so much fun sliding into the water.

Eva @ Pure Aloha Adventures was just excellent in EVERY way.  From weather watching to make sure they were safe to ensuring everyone was comfortable before during and after the experience.  I booked this for my grandson and sat on the shore and waited and watched.  Eva even made sure I was ok.  As a first experience in paddleboarding, I don't think Alexander could have asked for better.  He was leary coming in and committed to do this more often going out.  I highly recommend this adventure and am thankful for Eva and her expertise!!

It was my first time paddleboarding and now it will not be my last. Our instructor Eva was knowledgeable and wanted to teach us good form. Had fun learning even though I fell in a couple of times. Note to anyone who would like to try this don't skip those core workouts lol. 10/10 would recommend.
Easy, Simple, transaction. Thank you. Will use you again in the future.

Great time, lots of fun.
Really great staff and equipment!

Service was wonderful, the kids had a blast !

The 15 min. ride through the wake is 30 min. of lost fun time, 15 min. out then 15 min. coming back in. Will rent from beach next time so we get our full 2 hour of fun time. The employees  and equipt. we’re great.

We were very happy
We did get lost but we called and it all worked out

this was our first rental and we had a great experience! the staff was super friendly and helpful and made sure we were well prepared. The 4 hour rental was a bit long I think we would have been ok with 2.5-3 hours.

The was a little small not really a 4 seater it was also old I was worried we would break down but everything went ok. Employees were very friendly and were waiting on us when we got back to help get the boat in.

Another gentleman says yea no way we’re going out for at least 30 minutes maybe more. So I went and waited in the car then after 15-20 minutes they called saying we’re a go. Our guide Gabe was awesome.  He listened to what we expected out of our trip and he delivered.  We were able to see many dolphins up close, and we also got to zip around on the waverunners too.  Gabe was very personable and provided us a great experience.  We will definitely return!

We had so much fun!! Thank y’all!!

They couldn’t get the jet ski above 5 mph so it was boring and slow. But they did offer for us to come back for a free ride the next day and it should be fixed…but we couldn’t fit it in our schedule. Should have offered a partial refund tbh. I’d have perused it but we are on vacation so I shouldn’t have to do that. Again, they should have offered or given it!

Great boat, very fun time. The boat was well kept in good condition. Wished there was a bit more intel on Where to go once we headed out, or a bit more context to the map (ie, no you are here or anything).

Picking up our boat was super easy they had it cleaned and ready to go. They showed us all the different features and how to use them. Everyone was nice and even asked us how our day days was. The kids had a blast with the slide but I think they liked jumping off the top much more. We ran into a little rain shower and having the top helped keep us out of the rain until we got moved away from the area with lightning.
Fun afternoon with family
We rented the double decker party boat with a slide and all of our kids loved it. The staff was super friendly and helpful as well.

Boat was old and rundown down seats all ripped up. It rained most of the day only out their less then 2 hours and no refund cause of the weather. Would never recommend or use again!!!! Not worth the money for the condition of the boat!!!!
My first time there it was wonderful.

Wanted to do something different with my wife this year. This was perfect. The staff was courteous and very helpful. The jet ski was in good shape except the dry box lid wouldn’t stay latched down. Other than that, it was great. Will definitely do again!!
We had a good time the water was a little bit too rough. We would do it again another time.
The jet ski was awesome, we had so much fun and planning on doing it again.

We had a very good time! We booked the hour session. The men on the beach was so helpful on instructing us newbs on the sea doo. Just make sure to bring your cash tip and ID with you. Only complaint I had was finding where to go to sign in. It’s on the beach not in an actual building. 5 stars though!

We didn’t see any dolphins, but it wasn’t for lack of trying. We completely enjoyed just sailing around with nice people and nice.music.  I appreciated very reasonable prices on the soft drinks and snacks too. Would definitely go again!
Thoroughly enjoyed our afternoon trip. The crew were great. Enjoyed watching multiple dolphins. Everyone on the tour had a great time. This was our second trip with this boat.
My family had a great time on this tour. Seen several dolphins swimming about. Captain Johnny was entertaining and knowledgeable about the area.
This is the third year we have gone on the sailboat tour. Always a great time and staff are fun and friendly.
A wonderful sail the captain and crew member was awesome we will be back

Fun kayak nighttime activity.  Our guide was great!  However, flashlights were supposed to be provided but due to prior mishap none were available.  Given that tour was after dark - and we were walking in marshy/seaweed areas, lights were def needed.  Luckily my husband had thought to bring a small flashlight just in case.  Overall this was  a fun time.
Our guide was very informative showed us lots of creatures in the ocean we had a great time!

I had no experience kayaking but had no problem keeping up with the guide and the rest of the group. All the kayaks are 2 person kayaks. Our guide was very friendly and helpful. Your feet and your butt will get wet so be prepared. We did the 8pm crab grab so we could experience the glowing kayaks at night and it was so worth it. I would definitely do this again!
Awesome time! Andrew was a great guide! Being in the water at night with the glow kayaks was super fun for the kids and us adults. Definitely worth the trip if you are in the Gulf Shores area.
Colin and Alex were amazing tour guides. They were helpful, friendly, and lots of fun. We would definitely recommend this tour to any family looking to have an enjoyable experience while in the area!

It was great! My daughter and I went. I'm afraid of heights, & my husband had a terrible experience back in the day, but I always wanted to parasail, so we did!  It was her 2nd time. We even saw a sea turtle.

Fun ride! The location is nice for us staying at Kiva, but you are not on the parasail for 30 min. Our group left the shore, banana boat ride out, parasailed, had the other group parasail, banana boat ride back, gather our stuff, and walk to our car all in 1 hour. This site also has you pay a convenience fee, which I understand, but then on top of that adds a mandatory 15% gratuity once you arrive (be sure to bring your Apple Pay or CC). It's not gratuity or TIP when it's mandatory.

Lots of fun, very enjoyable, but whoever was driving the banana boat barely let my husband, the last person on, get seated and grab hold before taking off. I think he was too aggressive and didn’t have a safety first mindset. 

No one discussed any safety/emergency measures with us beforehand.  Otherwise, Lauren in the hut did a great job and was super friendly. The parasail boat captain and his deck hand were great too.

We enjoyed it -our first time-and would do it again.
Sawyer and Ryder did an amazing job. My family and I had a blast!

It was simple to book on the website and easy communication through email. 
Tickets came through email and that worked great!
Nine of us took the pontoon to a nearby sandbar and anchored. We waded and floated for a few hours and it was a highlight of the trip. Coolers and ice are provided if needed.

Jimmy made our dream and holiday excellent but we never knew they do not provide a driver and i think they should add it in the policy that a driver is not include. People like us who was trying to do this for the first time, we didn't know and the lady with dark hair was not helping at all but Jimmy changed our nightmare into something very beautiful. He was very understanding and patient. 

We will be back!
The staff was very helpful and the renting process was very easy.  Our family had a wonderful time!

The staff was nice and very helpful.  Location was great and there are endless areas available to go explore on the pontoon boat.  You would need to rent the boat for days to go see everything.  The boat ran great and was clean.  However, the interior was worn and the radio didn’t work.  I was provided a whistle to use for emergencies because the horn didn’t work either.  Overall it was a good experience.  It could have been a little better with some functional accessories.

Girl at the counter was nice and informative. Boat was a joke , moldy rip torn seats. Captains chair was broken. When I called to cancel because of weather they said no cancellations and it wasn’t raining??? I will never go back and I will tell everyone else to stay away.
Great renting right down from where we were staying.  Very convenient.  Staff very helpful and nice!
Everyone was very nice!! The jet skis were in good condition and ran good. Will be back next year!
Somehow I found this online book through these people was hard to find a place well worth going very smooth for jet skiing however $30 service fee exuberant

We requested two jet skis in Gulf Shores as a location and also requested to be in the bay. 
We were told that was confirmed and then we were actually given an address 20-30 mins away in Fort Morgan. Then when we showed up they only had one ski.
The attendants were amazing. They were very helpful  and friendly. The price was the best in the area. We will definitely use them again when we don’t bring our own boat.
Awesome boat, staff is knowledgeable and professional.
This was our family’s first boat rental experience. We had a wonderful time. The boat was spotless. We will definitely be doing this again!
Great people who we rented from. It was a really fun time!
Great Experience! The staff was very helpful! The boat rental was the favorite part of our trip!
Rachel and our pilot(I forgot his name but you rock bro) made sure we had a blast. Will definitely do it again!!
We really enjoyed the helicopter tour it gives you a new perspective of how gulf shores looks from the air
Planned this for my boyfriend and I and we had so much fun! We had the sweetest and most informative pilot. Will definitely do it again!
The flight was great saw a bunch of cool things. Will definitely do again when we come back.
Unfriendly pilot, starting place hard to finde, no information about the flight track, no information about the surcharge (for what?)

The boat trip was better than I expected, dolphins and wildlife were all over. The captain and his crew were awesome and kept everyone informed on what was on the bay and lots of history about the area. It was a great experience if you have never seen the dolphins close up. I would highly recommend this 2hour trip, well worth the time and money.
Great Captain and great crew. A lot of fun!
We had such a great experience from right when we were greeted at the booth till we returned back to the dock!
Very enjoyable excellent staff
It was very enjoyable, and sunset cruise is beautiful

Captain Matt knew exactly where to find numerous pods of dolphins! Several times we saw dolphins swimming together with there young. Matt even tempted the dolphins to swim behind the boat in its wake! He was also knowledgeable about the area and attractions around the bay. This was a truely exceptional experience!

They took us to see the lady of the lake and a few other spots telling us about the area. We got to quite a show with the dolphins and they even followed them some so we could see more. 10/10 absolutely wonderful! And having it just be our family and the captain/crew was perfect!
Our captain was amazing! I highly recommend taking a private tour. Able to maneuver to the dolphins way easier than a large tour, and just a more relaxed time.
Captain Don was excellent.
We had a great time . Don was a wonderful guide, saw Dolphins up close, and he had great music on board. Kids loved the whole experience
Great trip. Captain was great and even swung by the lady of the lake so my daughter could get a picture.
I was a surprise for my girlfriend she loves how they look and always wanted to drive one so I thought this would be a good opportunity to surprise her with one for the day and she loved it

Rented this during a storm week and it was raining when we picked it up.  The folks at gulf coast were very polite and friendly wiped out down for us and then we hit the road Eben in the rain it was a great experience for my entire family.

I would recommend Gulf Coast Rentals to anyone looking for great hassle-free customer service. Sarah was awesome! She had everything waiting & ready when we arrived. We will definitely do business there, again. COMPLETE SATISFACTION!!!!
Was a great experience and would love to do it again
Everything was great will be back soon
Very good trip. Communication was great and he tried to ensure that we did everything that we wanted to do during the time on board

Capt Matt was flexible with our time due to the weather which was amazing!  It still wasn’t a sunny day but we still made it a fun trip. The music was fun and on point and everyone danced all day and enjoyed the day. He was knowledgeable about points along the way which kept it interesting. We followed playing dolphins. He made sure we had plenty to see and do. Highly recommend and we will be repeat customers
Highly Recommend Captain Matt! Great Cook and awesome Captain!

We had an awesome time! The kids were so excited seeing the dolphins and the captain took his time and made sure they were able to see plenty. Great experience for us all! The Captain was from a town not far from where we live. We knew he lived in Louisiana, could tell by his accent.
Captain Don was great. Found us a secluded beach to swim and shell on.
He asked questions and made sure the we were given the chance to do what we wanted on the cruise
Captain Don was a great guide, full of knowledge that surpassed our expectations immensely! Money well spent!

My family (husband, 5 year old daughter, 3 year old son, and I) had a fantastic time on the boat ride. The Captain and Amy took great care of us and made sure our kids had the best time possible. Seeing the dolphins was a thrill for our kids and being out in the water on a beautiful boat was a highlight for the adults. This was the best day of our Gulf Shores trip!
Great time seeing dolphins. Excellent crew.
I have taken this cruise twice now, and it has been an excellent experience each time. The staff is always friendly.
The staff were wonderful and many dolphins. Only issue was the radio for the boat was sketchy so we didn’t hear a lot of what they said while out in the water
It was a blessing!!!

We live in Gulf Shores and have been on several different dolphin cruises.  Taking friends and family on a dolphin cruise is one of our favorite things to do.  This past weekend we were disappointed.  The captain usually makes the trip fun by pointing out the various bird species, landmarks, and anything else interesting to keep the patrons involved.  The ride was beautiful and that in itself is a good deal.  But a little more entertaining and interesting information could have made it much better.
Nice, smooth ride learning about OBA and Perdido. Matt was a great captain.

Cruise had me, my husband, and our 4 kids (23, 22, 17, 7). We all loved it. Captain Matt made sure we got to see dolphins and see them jumps the waves from his boat. He took us right across from the marina to a perfect spot for my girls to discover hermit crabs, see schools of tiny fish, and swim. It was a perfect day! This cruise made our whole trip.
We had a great time!  Captain Matt was fun and we couldn’t have asked for a better time. Our kids are still talking about it and we can’t wait to book again next year!!
Awesome guy very down to earth and knowledgeable about the area . Best boat ride we have had in orange beach hands down ! Will definitely book with him next year .

We have done several of the dolphin cruises over the years and decided to try a private tour. It was so worth it! We got plenty of dolphin spotting time in and then proceeded on a tour along Ono island and into the orange beach marina. Matt is very knowledgeable about the area and it was fun hearing some of the ‘inside scoop’ from a local. We will definitely be adding this to our next trip!

site_content.hero_text: Maggie's Cakes and More
site_content.hero_subtext: Handcrafted cakes, cupcakes, and pastries made fresh daily
site_content.about_text: Welcome to Maggie's Cakes and More! We've been serving the Gulf Coast community with handcrafted cakes, cupcakes, and pastries since 2018.

site_content.hero_text: The best burgers and fries in the Twin Ports!
site_content.about_text: Anchor Bar & Grill is a unique and popular restaurant and pub in Superior, Wisconsin, known for serving the best burgers and fries around. Featured on the TV show Diners, Drive-Ins, and Dives, this iconic dive bar offers a variety of homemade burgers and fresh-cut fries at great prices. The walls are covered with nautical memorabilia and artifacts. The restaurant features a game room and outdoor seating. Founded over 20 years ago, it's a must-visit destination in the Superior area.
site_content.hours_note: Open for dine-in at limited capacity. Outdoor seating available.

site_content.hero_text: Family Fun & Casual Dining - Dig into bold seafood boils & Cajun flavors
site_content.about_text: Angry Crab Shack is a casual Cajun/Creole-style seafood restaurant famous for its customizable seafood boils. Think crab, shrimp, crawfish, lobster, and more with bold Asian-Cajun sauces and spice levels. Beyond boils, many locations also offer appetizers, sandwiches, Po'Boys, fried seafood baskets, salads, and non-seafood options like chicken or burgers. Whether you are celebrating a big birthday, a milestone anniversary, or another special occasion, Angry Crab Shack is the place for a one-of-a-kind experience, with multiple locations worldwide. Delicious food, a fun environment, and a team of amazing staff make a visit to Angry Crab Shack memorable for everyone. Bibs are provided to keep shirts clean, but you can get as messy as you want as the tables are covered with paper. Those who do not love seafood can choose from flavorful Po'Boys, delicious cheeseburgers, juicy chicken sandwiches, and more. Angry Crab Shack even offers vegetable and tofu options for vegetarians.
site_content.hours_note: Hours vary by location. Check specific location page for details.

site_content.hero_text: Gulf Shores e-bike rentals with trail access. Shop pickup & free 2+ day delivery.
site_content.about_text: Amberjack E-bike Rentals offers family-friendly e-bike rentals in Gulf Shores, Alabama with convenient shop pickup and free delivery for 2+ day rentals. Easy to ride electric bikes with access to local trails.

site_content.hero_text: Lulu's
Family Owned Seafood Restaurant in Gulf Shores Since 1987
site_content.about_text: For over 35 years, Mikee's Seafood has been a Gulf Shores staple, serving up fresh, Southern-style seafood with a warm, family-friendly atmosphere. Proudly family-owned and operated since 1987, Mikee's is more than just a restaurant—it's a local tradition. Whether you're craving all-you-can-eat snow crab, a golden-fried seafood platter, or a refreshing Bushwacker from the bar, Mikee's is the spot where locals and visitors come together to eat, laugh, and make memories. The menu is packed with crowd favorites, from perfectly fried shrimp to grilled catch-of-the-day, all seasoned with that unmistakable Gulf Coast flavor.
site_content.hours_note: Open daily 11 AM to 10 PM

site_content.hero_text: Mile Marker 158 Dockside
A Southern Soul Food Revival
site_content.about_text: Moe's Original BBQ has been named in the Top 10 BBQ Chains in America by USA Today and The Daily Meal, one of the fastest growing, emerging restaurant chains by Restaurant Business Magazine, and one of the Top 10 Rib Joints in the U.S. by Relish. Moe's Original BBQ proudly serves up Alabama-Style Barbeque to customers across the country.

site_content.hero_text: Preserving Orange Beach's Native American and fishing heritage
site_content.about_text: The Orange Beach History Museum houses local artifacts and memorabilia relating to Native American and fishing heritage. Originally built in 1910 as a schoolhouse, it has served as a museum since 1995 and was moved to its present location in 1999. Families of early fishermen have donated supplies and collectibles that make visitors mindful of the challenges and achievements in the early days of the fishing industry. The facility underwent renovations completed in December 2023.
site_content.hours_note: Closed during most holidays, including the weeks of Christmas and New Year's. Group tours (five or more) may be booked at other times by making reservations.

site_content.hero_text: Education • Conservation • Adventure • Community
site_content.about_text: The Alabama Gulf Coast Zoo is home to a richly diverse and decidedly unique population of animals for a small-town community zoo. With 118 species and 22 critically endangered species, every animal has a name and a backstory. The zoo is committed to education, conservation, adventure, and community engagement. Located in Gulf Shores, Alabama, the zoo offers daily keeper presentations, animal adventures, and premium animal experiences.
site_content.hours_note: Open Daily 9 am - 4 pm

features.label: Vibe
features.value: Family-oriented, clean facilities, well-laid-out exhibits, friendly staff

features.label: Insider Tip
features.value: Giraffe feeding is a popular highlight; arrive early for the best animal activity levels

site_content.hero_text: OSO Alabama
Lower the Latitude Better the Attitude
site_content.about_text: Bahama Bob's is a beachside restaurant in Gulf Shores, Alabama, offering fresh seafood, burgers, and classic beach fare. Known for generous portions, crispy fries, excellent service, and a friendly, welcoming atmosphere. A local favorite for lunch and dinner with a cozy, clean dining environment perfect for families and groups.

site_content.hero_text: Beach Club Resort
Voted #1 Ribeye in the State of Alabama by Alabama Cattlemen's Association!
site_content.about_text: Big Mike's Steakhouse is a casual steakhouse that serves Certified Angus Beef and has been voted Alabama's Best Steak by the Alabama Cattlemen's Association. With multiple locations across Alabama, we offer a first-come, first-serve dining experience with full bars at each location. We specialize in premium steaks and offer weekly chef features, private parties, and catering services with custom grilling available for off-site events.
site_content.hours_note: First come, first serve seating. No reservations or call-ahead seating. All locations have bars for waiting guests.

site_content.hero_text: Burgers, Craft Beer & Cocktails
site_content.about_text: Bleus Burger in Gulf Shores, AL, elevates the humble burger to an art form. We specialize in gourmet craft smash burgers, alongside crispy wings, juicy tenders, and inventive sandwiches. Not just a burger joint, we offer vibrant veggie options and fresh salads. Pair your meal with a handcrafted cocktail or explore our selection of fifteen craft beers on tap. It's flavor, elevated. We use 100% FRESH CAB chuck, sourced from Alabama-based, family owned Evans Meats. All burger sauces are made in house daily. Our burgers are 100% fresh, NEVER frozen, premium CAB beef, hand-smashed to order.

site_content.hero_text: Alabama's southernmost brewery
site_content.about_text: Big Beach Brewing Company is Alabama's southernmost brewery, located in Gulf Shores, Alabama. The brewery features beer and wine on tap, live music, and events.

features.label: Vibe
features.value: Laid-back coastal brewery with a beach town feel

features.label: Insider Tip
features.value: Check the events calendar for live music nights which run later on weekends.

site_content.hero_text: Classic & Innovative Italian Cuisine
site_content.about_text: Located in Orange Beach, Alabama is a purveyor of fine Italian dining. Italian hospitality and innovated Italian cuisine that is guaranteed to grow your appetite. Enjoy choosing the perfect wine from our expansive collection to complement your meal as you sit in our dining room that combines contemporary decor with vintage Italian staples.

site_content.hero_text: Coastal Bakery
Great food, live music, and the best views of the Gulf of Mexico
site_content.about_text: COASTAL Orange Beach provides a waterfront restaurant, an open-air bar, and a lifestyle store all with tremendous beachfront views. Located directly on the sugar white sands, COASTAL offers beachfront breakfast, lunch, and dinner service. The restaurant serves fresh local seafood and unique culinary items from award-winning chefs. The beachside bar features live music, tropical cocktails, and fresh Gulf dishes. COASTAL Store offers apparel, accessories, beach gear, and coastal lifestyle products.
site_content.hours_note: Open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner daily

site_content.hero_text: The World Famous Beach Bar - Live Music 365 Days a Year
site_content.about_text: There are many stories about how the most famous beach bar in the country, the Flora-Bama Lounge, became the iconic location it is today. Some of the stories are even true and a few others were thought up on a local bar stool. The truth is that in 1962 the State of Florida gave the State of Alabama two miles of beach front land in return for the construction of the Perdido Pass Bridge. The Tampary family (Father Ted with sons Connie and Tony) decided to build a small bar and package store on the new State Line. The Flora-Bama was originally constructed in 1964, two years after the road was completed. In the early days of the Flora-Bama, the lounge was practically the only thing in the area. As traffic began to increase along the new highway, business grew and the lounge grew to match it with new construction added piecemeal to accommodate the larger crowds. At the time it was established Escambia County, Florida, in which it is located was "wet" while across the line Baldwin County, Alabama, was "dry". The Tamparys created a camaraderie rarely found among people of all ages and walks of life. Joseph Gilchrist purchased the tiny lounge and package store on April 17, 1978, and made live music a daily staple. Joined in 1986, by partner Pat McClellan, together they created calendar events like the "Interstate Mullet Toss" and the "Frank Brown Songwriter's Festival," named after the early, imposing night watchman. In 2009, John McInnis and Cameron Price became co-owners of the Flora-Bama, along with Joe and Pat, to carry it into the next 50 years. Together these four owners have carried on the tradition of making the Country's Best Beach Bar a place where everyone feels comfortable and leaves smiling. Today the live music at the Flora-Bama consist of local favorites to Platinum selling recording artist. The events range from chili cookoffs and fishing rodeos to the Annual Mullet Toss and big beach front concerts. The best part is there is always someone and something different going on at the Flora-Bama every day and you never know who is going to be sitting next to you.
site_content.hours_note: Main bar hours 11am-2:30am daily. Gift shop 9am-2:30am daily. Oyster Bar Sun-Thu 11am-11pm, Fri-Sat 11am-1am. Open 365 days a year.

Whether you are an experienced veteran or this is your first outing, experience the thrill of flying with the best adventure company on Alabama's Gulf Coast. We have the largest fleet of parasail boats in the area, and all of our vessels and crew are U.S. Coast Guard approved. site_content.about_text: Established in 1975 by Gerald King and David Bodenhamer in an old bait shop on a pier in Gulf Shores, Alabama, Sea-N-Suds is one of the original family-friendly beachfront restaurants in town. The restaurant stretches over the sugar-white sand and sits just a couple of feet away from the Gulf of Mexico, offering true beachfront dining. The original building was destroyed by Hurricane Frederic in 1979 and rebuilt. The restaurant still serves the same seafood using the same recipes passed down for generations, including their famous gumbo recipe from David Bodenhamer's grandmother, Nona Sellers, which has been in the family for over 200 years.

site_content.about_text: Climb aboard with a small group and get ready to fly! You will be safely harnessed in before the boat gently picks up speed, lifting you smoothly into the sky. Soar up to 400 feet above the Gulf of Mexico and take in breathtaking views of sugar-white beaches, crystal-clear turquoise water, marine life, and miles of coastline in every direction. Each flight lasts 8–10 minutes and is available for single, double, or triple riders. It's peaceful, thrilling, and unforgettable. Perfect for first timers and adventure lovers alike!
highlights: Enjoy panoramic views of the Gulf Coast on an Orange Beach: Dockside Parasail experience

Small group boat experience that is safe and perfect for first timers

restrictions: Participants must be at least 5 years old or older to ride on the boat or parasail.

qna.question: WHAT SHOULD I BRING?

qna.answer:
Most of our guests meet us at one of our launch locations, where we'll have your boat in the water and give you a quick safety rundown before you head out to explore.
You can launch from locations in :
*Orange Beach
*Gulf Shores.
Staying at a water front vacation rental? We may be able to deliver directly to you--as long as your location if in a safe boating area like no-wake zones or lake.
If it's safe, we'll bring the fun straight to your dock. Easy as that!

qna.question: CAN I USE MY CIRCLE BOAT IN THE GULF?

qna.answer:
No wake zones are the sweet spot.
Around Orange Beach you'll find gorgeous little islands with white sandy beaches, calm water, and even a few waterfront bars and restaurants you can pull right up to.
We'll give you a waterproof map that shows the best spots to explore, float, beach your boat, and enjoy the day safely. Island hopping+floating with your crew=best beach day ever!
qna.question: WHERE CAN I RIDE MY CIRCLE BOAT?

qna.answer:
Simple: look for the signs.
Also keep an eye on the speed of the boats around you. If everyone is cruising slowly, you're probably in a no-wake zone.
One friendly reminder:
Larger boats under power can't always maneuver quickly, and many are charter boats with professional captains.
So be courteous, stay in the designated  no-wake areas, and keep the  the vibe safe and chill for everyone on the water.
qna.question: HOW CAN I TELL WHERE THE NO-WAKE ZONES ARE?

qna.answer:
Nope---that's the beauty of it.
*  You must be 21 years old to rent
* Drivers must be at least 14 years old to drive.
These boats are incredibly easy to operate. Just point the motor where you want to go and turn the throttle.
We'll give you a quick safety briefing, and the you're ready to roll!
Seriously--if you can steer a shopping cart you can drive a circle boat!
qna.question: DO I NEED A BOATING LICENSE TO OPERAT A CIRCLE BOAT?

qna.answer:
First of all....don't panic. You'll have contact information, and if anything happens we'll come to you.  Often, one of our guides are on the water nearby.
Before every rental, our boats are fully charged 100%. The battery typically last up to 8 hours, depending on current, weight and how much cruising you do.
You can even connect to your battery via Bluetooth in the app to check battery life anytime.
And if you're battery dies there's an anchor onboard to keep your floating paradise right where you are.
qna.question: WHAT HAPPENS IF MY BOAT BREAKS DOWN?

qna.answer:
Extremely safe---and ridiculously stable.
You can stand up on them and they won't tip over. They're designed specifically for relaxed, low speed cruising.
Instead of a large engine, they use a small trolling motor with a protective propeller shield, making them safer for swimmers and sandbars.
Follow a few simple rules and you'll have a great day:
* Stay in no-wake zones
* Stay close to the banks as possible to stay out of other boaters way
* Be aware of other boaters
Do that and you're all set for one the safest, easiest, and most fun days you can have on the water.
* Respect the water
qna.question: HOW SAFE ARE CIRCLE BOATS?

qna.answer:
One person per boat unless you rent one of our 2-seater Circle Boats, which fits two.
But here's where it gets fun....
If you're coming with a group, you can rent a floating dock and tie up to 4 Circle Boats together. That means everyone can cruise around on their own boat and then link up to float, swim, snack, and hang out like your own little beach party. 🌴
Pro tip: Groups love this setup because everyone gets to drive their own boat and still hang out together on the water. Best of both worlds!
